svg.title: Test cases a team keeps, linked to the stories they cover — SoftTrack web design mockup (#274)
svg.desc: How to test the invoice page is known to whoever tested it last. A test case has a title, preconditions and numbered steps with what should happen; it lives in a folder, links to the stories it covers, has an owner and a state, and keeps its versions so that a run records what was executed.

svg.text: Done when a team can keep test cases with preconditions and numbered steps, in folders one level deep with labels across them; a case links to stories both ways and a story
